description: This Java source file defines the 'Record' class, which models a data record with fields, supports parsing from fixed-length and delimited lines, and handles various data types and conversions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Represents a data record with fields, capable of parsing and generating fixed-length or delimited string representations, supporting various data types and nested records.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Record instance from a ModelRecord.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Record instance from a ModelRecord and a fields map.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a Record from a line string, parsing fields based on ModelRecord definitions.

methods.name: createDelimitedRecord
methods.description: Creates a Record from a delimited line string, parsing fields with specified delimiter and text delimiter.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets a field value from a string, converting to appropriate data type based on field definition.

methods.name: getFixedString
methods.description: Returns a fixed-length string representation of a field's value, formatted according to its type.

methods.name: writeLineString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the record, formatted as fixed-length or delimited line.

methods.name: padFrontZeros
methods.description: Pads a string with leading zeros to a specified total length.
